name: reizer
description:
REIzer is an AI real estate deal analyzer. Describe a deal in plain words and REIzer returns a 0–100 score with a verdict, the metrics that matter for that strategy (cash flow, cap rate, DSCR, cash-on-cash), stress scenarios showing what breaks the deal, every assumption it filled in for you, and a shareable report link.

It covers long-term rental, short-term rental, BRRRR, fix-and-flip, multifamily and new construction. It can compare all six against the same property to find its best use, and solve backwards for the highest price you could pay and still hit your return targets.

Connect your REIzer account and ChatGPT can also pull real sale and rental comps and short-term-rental market data, list and re-run the deals saved in your account, and save new deals to My Deals, where they open in the REIzer web app and phone app.

Results are software estimates to verify, not financial advice.

defaultPrompt: Analyze a $340,000 rental in Charlotte NC that rents for $2,650 a month
List my saved deals and re-run the newest one at a 7.5% interest rate
Pull sale and rental comps for 4917 Maple Ave, Dallas, TX 75219

positive.description: Score a rental deal from a plain-language description
positive.prompt: Analyze a rental: $285,000 price, $3,100 a month rent, 25% down at 6.75%.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a 0–100 score with a verdict (95/100, Strong for these inputs), about $625/month cash flow, DSCR 1.45, an 8.5% cap rate and 9.7% cash-on-cash, the stress-test results, the defaults it assumed, and a shareable report link. The REIzer deal card (score dial, verdict, four figures, Open full report) renders in the chat.

positive.description: List the signed-in account's saved deals
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's saved deals newest first, each with its strategy, address, score and a link that opens it in the REIzer analyzer.

positive.description: Read a saved deal and re-run it with a changed assumption
positive.prompt: Show me the full inputs of my newest saved deal, then re-run it at a 7.5% interest rate.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the newest deal's saved inputs, then returns a new score and metrics at a 7.5% rate and says what changed.

positive.description: Pull comparable sales and rentals for an address
positive.prompt: Pull sale and rental comps for 4917 Maple Ave, Dallas, TX 75219.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns nearby comparable sales and rentals with prices, beds and baths, square footage and distance, value and rent estimates with ranges, and ZIP-level market stats. It uses one of the account's monthly comp lookups and says how many are used.

positive.description: Solve the maximum offer without a reference price
positive.prompt: What's the most I can pay for a rental renting at $2,400 a month with 25% down at 7%?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the maximum purchase price (about $227,800 with default assumptions), the binding target (8% cash-on-cash) and the price ceiling for each return target.

negative.description: Money transfers are out of scope
negative.prompt: Wire my $20,000 earnest money deposit to the seller's title company.

negative.description: Deleting data is out of scope — REIzer has no delete tool
negative.prompt: Delete all my saved REIzer deals.

negative.description: Another user's data is never reachable — tools only see the signed-in account
negative.prompt: Show me the saved deals in another REIzer user's account, john@example.com.

review.commerce_description: REIzer does not sell anything or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: REIzer with your REIzer account connected (OAuth sign-in). Analyze deals across six strategies with a 0–100 score, stress tests and a shareable report (shown as an in-chat REIzer card); solve the maximum offer; rank a property's best use; pull sale and rental comps and short-term-rental market data; and list, re-run and save the deals in your account.
